clue.text: Teas in preparation!

indicators.note: a preparation is something made up or mixed, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: An exclamation on seeing pots of tea being brewed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preparation' rearranges TEASIN; the whole clue also describes the answer, a herbal tea that is brewed.
explanation.definitionFit: An infusion of herbs or flowers is a kind of tea, made by steeping in hot water.

clue.text: Complete gutter around a small house

indicators.note: around tells us the gutter word wraps about the house abbreviation

parts.note: a trough is a channel or gutter for water
HO is the short form of house, as in a postal or map abbreviation

explanation.surface: A thorough job: a gutter running all round a little cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorough work is complete and leaves nothing out, a close synonym.

clue.text: Sort of city sure to offer protection against crime

indicators.note: to sort something is to rearrange it, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Some kinds of town are guaranteed to provide shelter from criminals.
explanation.definitionFit: Safety measures such as locks, guards and alarms are what keeps property safe from wrongdoers.

clue.text: Nothing Egyptian except an Egyptian flower

parts.note: nil means nothing, a zero score
E is a standard abbreviation for Egyptian, as in the Egyptian pound

explanation.surface: A boast that nothing in Egypt counts except one particular Egyptian bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is crossword shorthand for a river, something that flows, not a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The great river running through Egypt is a 'flower' in the sense of a thing that flows.

clue.text: Captain and sailor catch tuna

parts.note: skip, short for skipper, is a captain
Jack, as in Jack Tar, is a traditional name for a sailor

explanation.surface: The ship's master and a crewman land a big fish.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a striped species of tuna, a common commercial catch.

clue.text: Stay calm to avoid the guillotine

definitions.meaning: to remain composed in a crisis
literally, not to lose the top of one's body to the blade

explanation.surface: Advice to stay composed, or else lose your neck to the French executioner.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means remaining composed under pressure, and taken literally it means not being beheaded.

clue.text: Lodgings for tramps

definitions.meaning: a pad is slang for one's home or flat
to pad is to walk heavily or plod along, as a tramp does

explanation.surface: Places for vagrants to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for flats or digs, and also a verb for walking steadily on foot.

clue.text: First person admits to being employed and entertained

parts.note: am is the first-person form of the verb to be, as in I am
used means put to work or employed

explanation.surface: Someone confesses that they found having a job fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admits to' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To be entertained by something is to be diverted or made to smile by it.

clue.text: Young Tom Dodd embodies it to a T

indicators.note: embodies means takes into its body, so one name holds the other letters

parts.note: Ken Dodd was a famous Liverpool stand-up comedian
taken as written

explanation.surface: A comedian perfectly captures a particular quality.
explanation.walkthrough: Ken Dodd was a much-loved British comic. 'Tom' is a male cat, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A young male cat, a tom, is a baby cat.

clue.text: Esoteric way to conceal a heavenly body

definitions.meaning: mysterious, secret, supernatural

definitions.text: way to conceal a heavenly body
definitions.meaning: in astronomy, to cut off the light of a star or planet by passing in front of it

explanation.surface: An obscure method of hiding a star.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means mysterious or arcane, and as an astronomical verb means to block one body from view with another.

clue.text: Study only to accommodate oneself to change

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it, as at university
just means only or merely

explanation.surface: Advice to adapt by simply studying.
explanation.definitionFit: To adapt again is to adjust once more to new circumstances.

clue.text: Ring in perfect condition

definitions.meaning: to resound with a clear note, as a struck bell does
in excellent health or working order

explanation.surface: A bell's tone, and the idea of being in fine shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase is the clear tone of a struck bell; as an idiom it means healthy or flawless.

clue.text: Gore-bespattered monster

indicators.note: spattered means splashed about, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A creature covered in blood.
explanation.definitionFit: A fairy-tale giant that eats people is a classic monster.

clue.text: Pass on from a port in Panama

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to move along from a Central American harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Colón is a city and port at the Caribbean end of the Panama Canal.

clue.text: Nothing but the resting-place of Excalibur

definitions.meaning: only, no more than
King Arthur's sword was returned to a lake

explanation.surface: A reference to where Arthur's sword lies and nothing else.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means simply or only, and is also a poetic word for a lake, where Excalibur was thrown.

clue.text: Woman with a record is a timid creature

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a woman
an EP, extended play, is a kind of record

explanation.surface: A lady who has released a single turns out to be shy.
explanation.definitionFit: The farm animal is proverbially meek and timid, following the flock.

clue.text: Show embarrassment at being well-heeled

definitions.meaning: to go red in the face, to blush
rich, having plenty of money

explanation.surface: Someone blushing at being rich.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to redden in the face, and also, informally, to have plenty of money.

clue.text: Become irritated with what junkies yearn to do

definitions.meaning: a British idiom for getting annoyed
literally, to receive an injection from a syringe

explanation.surface: Becoming annoyed with drug users' cravings.
explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom means to grow annoyed, and literally means receiving a syringe, which addicts crave.

clue.text: A copper-lined box produced with precision

indicators.note: lined means having something inside along its walls, so the metal goes inside the box

parts.note: a crate is a box for transport
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A box with a copper lining, made with great care.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exact or correct in every detail has been done precisely.

clue.text: Co-operate for drama and dance

parts.note: a play is a drama on stage
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Working together to put on a show and a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to work along with others, to comply.

clue.text: Play a chemist produced is out of this world

indicators.note: produced means made or put together, so these letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A drama staged by a pharmacist is amazing.
explanation.definitionFit: Beyond the physical world, transcendent or abstract in a philosophical sense.

clue.text: Made Nixon's successor accommodate Anglicans

indicators.note: to accommodate is to make room for, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Gerald Ford followed Richard Nixon as US president
CE is the Church of England, the Anglican church

explanation.surface: A president obliged to house members of the Church of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Gerald Ford was the US president who took over when Nixon resigned.
explanation.definitionFit: Compelled, in the sense of having been made to do something.

clue.text: It could make one sick in the front of the ship

definitions.text: It could make one sick in the front of the ship

indicators.note: in tells us the illness word goes within the ship word

parts.note: the bow is the forward part of a ship
ill means sick

explanation.surface: Something at the prow likely to cause seasickness.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes a large wave crashing over the bows.
explanation.definitionFit: A great rolling wave at sea, the kind that brings on seasickness.

clue.text: Popular support for Old Dutch god

indicators.note: in a down light one piece would sit under another; here the popular word follows and props up the first

parts.note: O for old and D for Dutch are standard abbreviations
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: Fashionable backing for an ancient deity of the Low Countries.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief Norse deity, ruler of Asgard.

clue.text: Duct made of tin and aluminium

parts.note: a can is a tin container
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: A pipe made of two metals.
explanation.definitionFit: In anatomy a tubular passage in the body, such as the ear passage, is a duct.

clue.text: Obligation imposed on importers

definitions.meaning: something one is bound to do
a tax levied on goods brought into a country

explanation.surface: A requirement placed on traders bringing in goods.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a moral obligation and also a customs levy charged on imports.

clue.text: Boiled pudding is no good

definitions.meaning: a ... is a stodgy pudding boiled in a cloth, like plum ...
British slang for useless or faulty

explanation.surface: A complaint that the steamed dessert is a failure.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth-boiled dessert such as plum duff, and British slang for faulty or worthless.

clue.text: Just an exhibition

definitions.meaning: ...-minded, equitable
a trade show or funfair

explanation.surface: Simply a show.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means equitable, and also a trade show or funfair.

clue.text: Bacterial growths provided remedies around last month

indicators.note: around tells us the remedies word wraps about the month abbreviation

parts.note: cures are remedies
ult., short for ultimo, means last month in old business letters

explanation.surface: Lab samples of bacteria, provided that treatments surround the past month.
explanation.walkthrough: ULT, for ultimo, is old commercial shorthand for last month. 'around' puts ULT inside CURES after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: In a laboratory, microbes grown in a dish are colonies raised for study.

clue.text: Fruit always consumed by father

indicators.note: consumed by means eaten up, so one piece is swallowed inside the father word

parts.note: papa is a childish word for father
ay, also spelt aye, is an old word for always or ever

explanation.surface: Dad eats a piece of tropical fruit every time.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical fruit with orange flesh, also called pawpaw.

clue.text: Ruin an Ulster county before autumn

indicators.note: before tells us the county comes ahead of the season

parts.note: County Down is one of the six counties of Northern Ireland
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: Disaster strikes a Northern Irish county ahead of the autumn.
explanation.walkthrough: Down is a county in Northern Ireland, part of the historic province of Ulster.
explanation.definitionFit: Collapse or undoing, as in someone's fall from power.

clue.text: Alternative transaction results in a trial

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
a deal is a business transaction

explanation.surface: Another business arrangement ends up in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A painful experience that tests someone is a trying test of endurance.
